data.one_liner: Generate Dart code using custom annotations defined alongside your source files.
data.what_it_does: Provides base annotation classes and a @CodeGen() library annotation to run custom code‑generation logic during build_runner builds. Developers implement apply() to emit classes, extensions, mixins, etc., into generated .g.dart (or other) files.
use_when: You need custom code generation without writing a separate builder package
You want to define annotations and generation logic in the same project
You prefer a simple setup with build_runner
avoid_when: You only need standard JSON/serialization code (use json_annotation)
You require runtime reflection instead of build‑time generation
strengths: Minimal boilerplate to start generating code
Supports multiple generation targets and hooks
Leverages code_builder for correctly formatted output
data.setup_notes: Add super_annotations as a dependency and build_runner as a dev_dependency, then annotate libraries with @CodeGen() and run pub run build_runner build
